admission.justification: The recorded behavioral fixture assertions guard this obligation; the proof facets distinguish their limited fixture behavior from real-host or full-final acceptance.

applicability: FIFO held deliveries to a host with a stable monotone byte-size admission limit.
conditions: Attempt the whole remaining FIFO batch before treating any earlier accepted size as a budget.
A refused whole probes descending complete-message prefixes.
Sender attribution and whole messages are retained in each admitted part.
exclusions: A transient busy refusal is not proof of a permanent byte capacity.
Splitting a single message into fragments or summarizing its text.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_held_queue.py variable-length two-delivery and six-message three-delivery tests pass; scratch/worker/5e0b3a10-7a35-4c5e-9f11-100000000001/xdg/r6-probe-after.txt sha 628ed08eb73c: 214-byte witness accepted [191,214] actual=2

statement: A delivery larger than the host admits is split into the minimum admitted deliveries in order: the whole remainder is attempted first, a refused whole probes down for the longest fitting prefix, and the learned budget is a lower bound only.
